categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: titanium alloy precision casting, rubber and sealing materials, aircraft cockpit transparent components, and high-temperature alloy master alloys. These segments focus on the research, production, and sales of advanced materials and components mainly for aerospace applications, including aviation engines, aircraft, helicopters, and spacecraft, as well as applications in shipbuilding, weaponry, electronics, nuclear industry, railways, bridges, chemical engineering, and biomedical fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced titanium alloy precision casting with capabilities for large, complex, thin-walled, and high-precision components; specialized rubber and sealing materials with high temperature, corrosion resistance, and multifunctional properties; manufacturing of organic and inorganic glass transparent cockpit components with integrated functions like electromagnetic shielding and bird strike resistance; and high-temperature alloy smelting and casting technologies including vacuum induction melting and purification. The company employs digital simulation, additive manufacturing, and integrated process controls to enhance product quality and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are major domestic and international aerospace manufacturers, including aviation engine and aircraft producers, helicopter manufacturers, and aerospace organizations. The company also serves defense, shipbuilding, nuclear, chemical, automotive, biomedical, and high-speed rail sectors. Key customers include China Aviation Industry Group, China Aviation Engine Group, Safran, GE Aviation, Rolls Royce, Honeywell, and Airbus.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales domestically and growing export sales internationally. Export markets include global aerospace manufacturers and related industries. The company maintains strategic partnerships with international aerospace firms and supplies components for global civil aviation engines and aircraft.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the aerospace materials supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of advanced materials and components. It supplies critical structural parts and materials to downstream aerospace manufacturers and integrates upstream raw material processing with downstream component production and technical services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven growth, focusing on advanced aerospace materials and manufacturing technologies such as lightweight high-performance titanium alloys, multifunctional rubber sealing materials, high-performance transparent cockpit components, and high-purity high-temperature alloys. The company emphasizes digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and green production processes. R&D efforts target overcoming key technical bottlenecks, developing new materials like Ti-Al intermetallics, enhancing product quality, and expanding applications in civil aviation and new markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aerospace materials and components, including titanium alloy castings, rubber and sealing products, transparent cockpit components, and high-temperature alloy master alloys. The company also earns income from technical services, research and development contracts, and sales of related processing services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to aerospace manufacturers and related industries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic position in aerospace materials, especially as the main supplier of titanium alloy precision castings and high-temperature alloy master alloys in China. It competes internationally with major aerospace materials suppliers such as PCC, Howmet Aerospace, Cannon Muskegon, Dow Corning, Hutchinson, and PPG. The company is recognized for its advanced technology, comprehensive product portfolio, and strategic partnerships with global aerospace firms, positioning it as a key player in the aerospace materials industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.8 billion, representing a 20.01% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 576 million, a 30.23% increase. Total assets reached RMB 11.5 billion, growing 181.97% from the previous year, and net assets attributable to shareholders increased by 286.49% to RMB 10 billion. The company has shown strong growth driven by increased orders and enhanced operational efficiency, supported by significant capital raised through its 2023 IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique value proposition in delivering high-quality, technologically advanced aerospace materials and components with domestic independent intellectual property rights. It offers comprehensive solutions integrating R&D, production, and technical services, with capabilities in manufacturing complex, lightweight, and high-performance titanium alloy castings, specialized rubber sealing materials with multifunctional properties, advanced transparent cockpit components, and high-purity high-temperature alloys. Its products meet stringent aerospace standards and support national strategic needs, providing customers with reliable, innovative, and cost-effective materials critical for aerospace and defense applications.
